item.title: LinkedIn Headshot From Park Photo

turns.text: Can you turn this into a square LinkedIn headshot? A navy blazer and a plain light grey background, please.

item.tests: Creates a polished LinkedIn headshot from the supplied photo while preserving the subject's identity.

answer_sheet.Clothing and background: Navy blazer and plain light grey background.
answer_sheet.Lighting and expression: Natural, approachable and professional; keep my smile.

must_haves: The woman is recognisably the same person as in portrait-woman.jpg, with her curly dark hair retained.
The park is replaced with a plain light grey background.
The square image has a centred head-and-shoulders composition with the full top of her hair visible.
Lighting and skin texture look natural, without obvious facial or clothing artifacts.

turns.agent:
I couldn't make the headshot. Magic Hour turned the request down because your account doesn't have enough credits. The headshot tool costs 50 credits, so nothing was created and you weren't charged.

You have two ways to go:

1. **Add credits and use the headshot tool.** If you buy a credit pack or upgrade your plan, I can run the same request again.
2. **Try a cheaper photo edit instead.** The image editor on your free plan starts at 5 credits per image (flux-2-klein at 640px). I could ask it to make your photo look like a professional headshot, for example with a plain studio background, soft lighting and a tighter crop. The image would be smaller than a real headshot, and I don't know your credit balance, so I can't promise it will go through.

Should I try option 2, or would you rather add credits first?
